scripts.typecheck: npm run build && tsc -p examples/flights --noEmit && tsc -p examples/flights/tsconfig.browser.json && tsc -p examples/hello --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run typetest && npm run storetest && npm run smoke
scripts.prepublish-check: npm run test && npm run packtest
scripts.example:flights: npm run build && HAI_SCRIPTED=1 node examples/flights/src/server/main.ts
scripts.example:hello: npm run build && HAI_SCRIPTED=1 node examples/hello/src/server/main.ts
scripts.release: npm run build && npx changeset publish
